query: Translate this comic into English with the comic-translator skill.
files_as: one .zip of the four pages, in this order
expected_behavior: Runs detect, render and pack from the skill's folder with `uv run scripts/run.py`, without reading or copying the scripts
Asks before installing uv when it is missing, and installs it only after a yes
Translates every speech bubble: '...y el toque final.' becomes '...and the final touch.' or close
Leaves the sound effects drawn on the art (SHH SHH, PLOP) as they are, by deleting their entries
Keeps every box as detect wrote it unless fixing it, and render reports no warnings
Letters the title page's 'Pepper and Carrot / Episode 1: …' once, whole, with no word cut by another box
Packs the four translated pages with pack into pepper-carrot-ep01-es-english.zip next to the input, and hands it over

Hands over the translated page, packed with pack next to the input

query: Translate this comic to English, then fix anything that still looks wrong.
expected_behavior: Looks at the result-boxes sheets after rendering
Renders again after any edit, and stops once the page is clean
When a command is still running, waits by sending the identical command, never a changed one

query: Translate this comic into English with the comic-translator skill. Your bot can run 3 workers at once.
files_as: one .zip of the twelve pages, in this order
expected_behavior: Acts as Prepare: runs detect, then stops before reading any page
Writes {} to names.json in the work folder
Reports ready with 'The chapter has 12 pages, so it is translated in 3 parts.'
Lists three Part task lines to start now, each to translate pages 000-003, 004-007 and 008-011 into English and render them, with the work folder's full path
Lists one Combine task line to start only after every part reports ready, that packs the work folder and hands over <input>-english.zip next to the input

query: Part: translate pages 000-001 of the chapter in <work folder> into English and render them, with the comic-translator skill.
files_as: a work folder made by detect from one .zip of the four pages, holding names.json with {"Pepper": "Pepper"}
expected_behavior: Reads and edits the notes of pages 000 and 001 only, and leaves 002 and 003 untouched
Translates into English, the language its task names, with no translation left the same as its original unless it already reads right
Reads names.json before each page and keeps 'Pepper' as it is
Adds any new name it meets, such as 'Carrot', to names.json without dropping 'Pepper'
Renders pages 000 and 001 only, naming them after the work folder, and looks at their result-boxes sheets
Reports ready, once both pages are clean, with how many pages and entries it translated

query: Combine: pack the chapter in <work folder> with the comic-translator skill, and hand over <input's folder>/chapter-english.zip.
files_as: a work folder made by detect from one .zip of the four pages, with pages 000 and 001 translated and 002 and 003 as detect left them
expected_behavior: Runs pack, which refuses and names pages 002 and 003
Does not read, translate or render any page itself
Reports blocked, naming pages 002 and 003 and the part task that holds them
Hands over no zip
